product_family: Inciteful is a multi-product suite for academic research and medical insights. The Academic version (incitefulmed.com/academic/) provides citation-network based paper discovery; the Medical version (incitefulmed.com) delivers AI-powered evidence-based medical insights from 40M+ peer-reviewed studies. Free, open-data academic tool with US-based operations.

privacy.ai_training_note: Terms of Use grant Inciteful 'worldwide, royalty-free, non-exclusive...right to use, reproduce, modify, adapt' user-provided content for service improvement. Third-party LLMs are used for analysis. No explicit data training opt-out provided; users are warned not to input PII. De-identified datasets may be created for 'any lawful purpose.'

products.name: Inciteful Academic
products.data_scope: Academic papers, citations, research metadata. Users should NOT input PII or sensitive data.
products.notes: Free, citation-network based paper discovery tool. Covers 240M+ academic papers and 2B+ citations. Built on open data. No enterprise security posture.

products.name: Inciteful Med
products.data_scope: Medical symptoms, health information, research queries. Warns: do NOT input PII, personal identifiers, or medical records.
products.notes: AI-powered evidence-based insights from 40M+ peer-reviewed studies. Explicitly NOT medical advice. For informational purposes only. Users must verify findings with healthcare providers.

compare.pricing_model: Free (Academic). Medical version pricing not disclosed.
compare.data_residency: United States only; no EU/regional residency options.

flags: The vendor explicitly disclaims all security, reliability, and accuracy guarantees in its terms of service.
No GDPR safeguards, DPA, or privacy shield arrangements are documented, and the privacy policy explicitly warns international users that US data protection laws differ from their jurisdiction.
The vendor holds no SOC 2, ISO 27001, ISO 27017/18/701, HIPAA, PCI DSS, ISO 42001, CSA STAR, or FedRAMP certifications.
The terms grant broad rights to user-provided content for 'service improvement' via third-party LLMs, with no explicit training opt-out. Users are warned not to input PII.
No Data Processing Agreement or third-party vendor security reviews are published.
Maximum liability is capped at $100 USD, and disputes are resolved through binding individual arbitration only.
Inciteful Med explicitly disclaims being medical advice or a substitute for healthcare provider consultation.
All data is processed in the United States, with no regional data residency options.
The service uses third-party LLM providers and analytics services; the data sharing implications are not fully detailed.
